subject: Invoice routing decision: webhook ACK patterns and minimal line-item template
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-systems.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@acme-systems.com
Date: 2028-04-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: New supplier onboarding — invoice delivery question

Hi Naomi,

We’re finalizing our Redwood onboarding and have a quick question about preferred invoice delivery. Our ERP can either: (a) push invoices to your portal (via SFTP or webhook), or (b) email invoices to billing@redwood.com.

Two specifics we need to confirm:
- Does Redwood require a specific subject token/PO format when sending invoices by email (e.g., "PO: 12345 | INV: 98765")?
- If you prefer portal/webhook, what ACK pattern should our system expect (immediate 200 vs delayed async ACK with request id)?

I attached an example invoice and our current minimal line-item CSV to illustrate what we’d send.

Thanks — we want to avoid go-live rework.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Billing Operations, Acme Systems
attachments: acme_invoice_sample.pdf, acme_lineitems.csv

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-systems.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — invoice delivery question

Hi Elena — great timing. Short answers up front, then details below.

Preferred: portal/webhook for volume and automatic ACKs. Email is acceptable as a fallback but we need a reliable subject convention.

What we'll do on our side:
- Portal webhook: we return an immediate 200 with request_id and acceptance_status (ACCEPTED/PENDING). For PENDING we follow up with an async final ACK (webhook callback or portal status poll) within 24 hours.
- Email fallback: subject must include PO# (PO:####) and vendor tax id or short vendor code; body or attachment must include line-item rows in CSV or a PDF with a clear table.

Connor/Vanessa — tagging you for SLA and PO-stamping confirmation (we may require PO stamping for multi-PO invoices).

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Procurement Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — invoice delivery question

Thanks Naomi. A couple of implementation notes for Elena:

1) PO stamping: If a single invoice covers multiple POs, we prefer the vendor to add a PO column on the CSV line items. If the vendor cannot, we can accept invoice-level PO list in the invoice header (comma-separated), but that increases manual routing.

2) Email subject token: please use this exact pattern when emailing: "PO:12345;Vendor:ACME;INV:98765" — semicolons avoid punctuation collisions. We will parse subject first, then fall back to attachment.

3) ACK semantics for webhook: immediate 200 + JSON payload: {"request_id":"<uuid>","status":"RECEIVED"}. Followed by final status webhook with status INVOICED / REJECTED and optional reason. If you cannot do callbacks, we can poll the portal for status (every 15 minutes up to 6 hours).

Vanessa — can you confirm if we need a vendor-specific tax-id field in the subject for AP validation?

Connor

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — invoice delivery question

Confirming: we prefer vendor code in the subject for routing. Tax ID is not required in the subject if vendor code exists, but must be present in the invoice header or vendor master during onboarding. For go-live, ask Acme to include both vendor code and PO in the subject for the first 48 hours so we can validate parsing.

Also adding the minimal line-item template (CSV) we recommend — one row per line item, columns: PO, LineNumber, ItemDesc, Qty, UnitPrice, Currency, TaxAmount. Naomi — should we attach that template to this thread so Elena has the canonical copy?

Vanessa Ortiz
AP Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-systems.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@acme-systems.com
Date: 2028-04-14T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding — invoice delivery question

Thanks Naomi/Connor/Vanessa — this is helpful. A few final confirmations before we schedule go-live:

- We will implement the webhook and send the immediate 200 + JSON request_id payload. Our devs will also implement the final status callback.
- For email fallback, we will adopt the subject pattern: "PO:12345;Vendor:ACME;INV:98765" for the pilot.
- Attached is our stripped-down CSV export that maps to your minimal line-item template; see file: redwood_minimal_lineitem_template.csv (we removed customer-only fields).

We’d appreciate an example of the async final ACK payload so our team can validate end-to-end. Can you drop a sample JSON for that?

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Billing Operations, Acme Systems
attachments: redwood_minimal_lineitem_template.csv
